**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Identify each precision pass in sweep log records**

For a quality manifest with multiple precision fixtures, every precision event emitted here contains the same `runIndex` and neither a fixture ID nor a request kind; the later recall event uses the same event name and index as well. Although the JSON summaries are now nested per fixture, the required log evidence cannot be attributed to a particular precision pass. Include at least `kind: "precision"` and the fixture ID in each emitted record.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.
